modern: Within ten days you will seem a god to those to whom you are now a beast and an ape, if you return to your principles and the worship of reason.
original: Within ten days thou wilt seem a god to those to whom thou art now a beast and an ape, if thou wilt return to thy principles and the worship of reason.
